def VTask.strongDownwardInduction : {α : Type u_1} -> {p : Multiset α → Sort u_3} -> {n : ℕ} -> (H : (t₁ : Multiset α) → ({t₂ : Multiset α} → t₂.card ≤ n → t₁ < t₂ → p t₂) → t₁.card ≤ n → p t₁) -> (s : Multiset α) -> s.card ≤ n → p s :=
  fun {α} {p} {n} H s hs =>
    let
      -- Define the set of multisets with cardinality at most n
      S : Set (Multiset α) := {s | s.card ≤ n}
      -- Define the relation < restricted to S
      R : Set (Multiset α × Multiset α) := {⟨s, t⟩ | s ∈ S ∧ t ∈ S ∧ s < t}
      -- Use well-founded recursion to perform the induction
      f : ∀ (s : Multiset α), s ∈ S → p s :=
        fun s hs =>
          H s
            (fun {t₂} ht₂ hst =>
              -- For each t₂ > s with t₂.card ≤ n, use the recursive call to f
              f t₂ ht₂)
            hs
    -- Apply f to s with the proof that s.card ≤ n
    f s hs
